title: chessformer_lens: an interpretability lens for square-token chess transformers
description: A toolkit and visualizer for mechanistic interpretability of transformer-based chess models that tokenize the board by square, with Maia-3, Leela Chess Zero (BT4, T82) and DeepMind searchless chess (9M, 136M, 270M) backends. Provides an interp core (hooks, logit lens, causal head and neuron ablation, depth traces) plus an interactive app: live attention, a neuron panel, and a one-move analysis of the logit lens, causal heads and causal neurons.
